critical_code_review_comments: admin_tools.recycle_bin runs a full _purge_expired() on every GET which iterates all 10 collections. Fine for now but consider a scheduled job / rate-limit if the bin grows.

hrd_ai.upload_cv: on AI failure the temp CV file is unlinked but on parse-JSON success path, the file is kept indefinitely with no cleanup when a candidate is later soft-deleted (soft_delete_one does not unlink CV_DIR/{cid}{ext}). Storage leak over time.
hrd_ai.ocr_ktp: temp file is unlinked in finally — good. But NIK returned as raw string with no length/format validation; downstream form should re-check 16-digit.
hrd_ai.save_ai_letter: does not honor payload.tingkat_sp validation (SP1/SP2/SP3) — free string. Minor; UI restricts anyway.
admin_tools.backup: to_list(100000) hard cap could truncate silently on very large collections; consider a warning header or streaming JSONL per collection.
